articles.title: ₹271 crore for one penthouse: DLF's The Dahlias sets new luxury benchmark
articles.summary: Gurugram's luxury real estate market is booming, highlighted by a 271 crore penthouse fetching 2.6 lakh per sq ft. This trend signifies Gurugram's rise as a top luxury destination, now competing with Mumbai. Such high-value transactions reflect robust investment and demand in India's key urban centres, showcasing economic dynamism relevant for general awareness.

articles.title: GeM gross merchandise value surges from ₹422 cr to over ₹1.55 lakh cr in a decade: Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has achieved a remarkable Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) exceeding 1,55,000 crore, a significant leap from 422 crore a decade ago. This rapid growth underscores the successful transition to an end-to-end digital platform for public procurement in India, streamlining government buying processes and promoting transparency and efficiency across various sectors, benefiting taxpayers.

articles.title: GeM gross merchandise value surges from Rs 422 crore to over Rs 1.55 lakh crore in a decade: Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has achieved a significant milestone, recording a Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) exceeding Rs 1,55,000 crore. This represents a massive growth from just Rs 422 crore a decade ago, driven by the shift towards end-to-end digital public procurement. This initiative significantly enhances transparency and efficiency in government buying processes across the nation.
